does: Gives one kind of a spell prototype's conditions (eoc::spell::Condition, 0x18 bytes) for one text key: RCX the SpellPrototype, RDX the condition written, R8 the eoc::spell::ESpellConditionsType (1 the spell roll), R9 a FixedString pointer, the text key.

evidence.says: a switch over R8 picks the stats property name of that kind of condition and looks it up per text key; the macOS build anchors the name

called with type 1 and the spell's default text key it returns condition id 1 for Target_MainHandAttack and 0x35 for Target_Shove, the ids the AI passes to eoc::spell::CalculateModifiableSpellRollChance for those spells; with the text key of CastOffhand it returns id 2
